_comment: NEGATIVE CONTROL for layout/erc/adc_block.supply-spec.json. Not an
item-11 artifact -- never cite this run as evidence about this block.
Byte-identical to the supply spec except that `nets[]` declares
`vdd_not_a_real_net` in place of `vdd`. Nothing in adc_block.gds
carries that label, so `erc.unconnected_net` MUST fire exactly once,
naming it.
WHY THIS EXISTS. The supply spec's whole claim rests on an ABSENCE:
zero `erc.unconnected_net` findings. An absence is only evidence if
the rule that would have produced it was actually live -- a spec that
silently failed to register its label layer, or a `klt` build whose
net checks never ran, would produce the same clean report. This case
is what distinguishes `the rail is one island` from `nothing was
looking`. It is the same argument layout/drc/cells/'s negative control
makes for the DRC deck (layout/README.md, `The negative control`).
`vss` is left correct on purpose, so a run of this case reports ONE
finding rather than two: the control isolates the typo'd name.
ISSUE #356: this control carries the supply spec's own `ties[]`
declaration verbatim, so it still differs from the artifact in exactly
one stated way. The tie is expected to come back clean here too -- it
is not what this control is probing.
